question: How should knowledge be handled in relation to the world?
premises: If known here, the world would not be destroyed.
When known again, knowledge-removal should be practiced.
inference: Knowledge is to be given and, upon renewed knowing, withdrawn; knowing here prevents destruction of the world.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic link of 'even if unknown' is unclear.
Token segmentation and grammatical roles are approximate.
The previous verse's guru-trust context is only loosely connected.
plain_english: If this is known here, the world would not be destroyed; knowledge should be bestowed; even if it is unknown, when it is known again, one should practice the removal of knowledge.
